briefs.body: Write the single authoritative loadout table for the Batmobile, one row per BmAK weapon or gadget, one column per mode, plus the button. Start from Working/Q/PILOT/CONTROLS.md rows 10-18, Working/Translation/T7_WEAPONS.md section 1 and the finished reports of 7943 and 7950. Operator facts that decide the cells: pursuit fires only the EMP missile (Immobiliser); tracking and boost are pursuit-only and are gadgets, not weapons; the tracker HUD persists into battle; battle has the cannon on RT, the Vulcan on RB, the barrage that fires itself at lock, the EMP burst, hacker and sonar. Give each cell one of: fires, gadget, absent, UNKNOWN, with the source file and line. Do not invent buttons that no file names. Output: Working/Roadmap/weapon_loadout.md and weapon_loadout.json (keys: wpn, bmak_class, pursuit, battle, button, source). Done-check: the json parses and has 11 weapon rows plus the booster, sonar and winch rows, no empty cell. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Two record clashes make small models misread the weapon plan. First: GRAB_BACKLOG.md line about D-3 says to accept JC3 lethality with no toggle (2026-10-28), while the 2026-11-06 ruling makes the riot suppressor a zero-damage impulse tune on a second weapon entity (T_ROWS.jsonl rows T-WP10 and T-WP14). Second: Research/specs/B-24.md and B-25.md (lock hold, reticle) share numbers with the handling and flare cards of GRAB_BACKLOG.md, and B-15 means three things (tmp/freebuff/reports/pilot-card-combat-and-gadgets.md section 1). Produce Working/Roadmap/weapon_record_fixes.md: a table of each clash, the exact file and line of every side, and one proposed rename or one-line amendment text, with no edit to the originals. Include the already-written findings of 7947 if they overlap. Done-check: every clash row has two file:line citations and a proposed text that fits on one line. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The lock-on cone cannot be written until the unit of the AutoAim angle fields is known: 0.15 might be a turn fraction (54 degrees) or radians (8.6 degrees), and BmAK wants a 40 degree cone. Search the sources in this order: tmp/freebuff/reports/exe-entity-swap-consumer.md and Research/JC3Grab/WEAPONS.md, then values of the shipped AutoAim entries that have a known real-world cone (turret or aircraft cones named in Research/JC3Grab/TURRET.md), then the decoded exe consumer of that struct if 9050 found one. Compare at least three shipped entries against their described behaviour. Output: tmp/freebuff/reports/autoaim-angle-unit.md with a verdict (turns, radians, degrees or UNKNOWN), the evidence list, and the exact in-game observation that would settle it if still UNKNOWN. Done-check: the report states the cone value to write for 40 degrees under each candidate unit. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Settle three open lock facts with evidence, not memory. (1) What MissileLockOnDuration 2.0 s governs in BmAK (pursuit circle, battle diamond, or neither): read Research/BatmobileGrab/WEAPONS.md and FOOTAGE.md (LockOnTime 233 samples, maximum 1 s). (2) Where the decoded MaxTargets 8 came from, given the operator-confirmed 1/4/7/10 targets by upgrade level; record the conflict, do not overwrite it. (3) The target sort key: the operator is unsure between crosshair-nearest first and proximity second; list what tmp/freebuff/reports/bm-lock-target-sort-key.md and bm-lock-duration-and-cone.md support. Operator facts: the barrage auto-fires at lock; battle lock is an instant orange diamond; pursuit lock is a shrinking circle. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/lock-semantics-settled.md with one row per question: answer, evidence, UNKNOWN flag. Done-check: three rows, each with at least one file citation or the word UNKNOWN. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Extract the Vulcan crosshair bloom curve from the operator capture in C:/Users/User/Videos/Captures named VulcanFire_10s-15s.mp4 (the Arkham Knight file, fire window about 10 s to 15 s; list the folder to get the exact name). Build on the report of 7945 and tmp/freebuff/reports/vulcan-capture-fire-and-overheat-timing.md. Pull frames with ffmpeg into your own folder under the scratchpad, never into the repo, and measure the reticle spread in pixels at a fixed frame step, the first frame where the reticle turns red, and whether fire ever stops (operator fact: bloom, then red, no lockout). Output: Research/BatmobileGrab/VULCAN_BLOOM.json with arrays t_seconds, spread_px, is_red, plus the fit (linear or eased) and the red threshold. Add one sentence on what input scale the HUD call UC_SetMachineGunAccuracyFrame would need, or UNKNOWN. Done-check: the json has at least 20 samples and the red-threshold frame is cited. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Finish the one unstarted weapon-adjacent grab row G3-06g in GRAB_BACKLOG.md: RJokerMissileTarget, the launcher particle and mesh components, and the RBatmobileMissileLauncherJoker class (11th class in G1-08, 25 fields, 2 instances, effect Batmobile_JokersRocket_Trail). Read Research/BatmobileGrab/WEAPONS.md, objects.jsonl and Working/Translation/T7_WEAPONS.md line 43. List every field with its decoded value, the two instance names, which mission or mode references them, and the mesh and effect assets they point at. Mark every field you cannot decode as UNKNOWN. Output: Research/BatmobileGrab/JOKER_LAUNCHER.md and a one-line status update proposal for the tracker row (do not edit the tracker). Done-check: 25 field rows present and the two instances named. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Decide whether the Joker missile launcher belongs in the release and give it a ledger row. Read Research/BatmobileGrab/JOKER_LAUNCHER.md, the D-5 skin decision in GRAB_BACKLOG.md and the loadout table Working/Roadmap/weapon_loadout.md. Apply the closest-system rule of STAGES.md: if it is a Joker variant of the barrage, name the JC3 launcher it reuses (the w618 clone) and the gap (trail effect, target type); never answer that JC3 has no system. Propose a WPN code and a T_ROWS.jsonl-format row as text in Working/Roadmap/joker_row_proposal.jsonl (do not touch T_ROWS.jsonl) with disposition, carrier, why, and the owner brief. Operator question to leave for the operator: is the Joker launcher required for release. Done-check: the jsonl line parses and has keys id, carrier, disposition, why. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Both BmAK treadmark-following assets used by sonar are recorded as missing-object. Locate them or settle permanently. Read tmp/freebuff/reports/sonar-and-scan-pulse.md section 4, the report of 7962, Research/BatmobileGrab/AUDIO_BANKS2.md lines 154-169 and the package reads under Research/BatmobileGrab (objects.jsonl). Search each asset name across every exported package index, with at least three spelling variants. Operator fact: tread-mark following is mission specific and sonar outside missions is visual and audio only, so this is low priority; spend at most the time budget. Output: tmp/freebuff/reports/sonar-treadmark-assets.md: for each asset, found (path and object id) or not-found with the searches tried, and the verdict PERMANENT-UNKNOWN or located. Done-check: both assets have a verdict line and a list of at least three searches. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Write the per-weapon damage table that the combat predictions lack. Sources: Research/BatmobileGrab/DAMAGE_RULES.md, WEAPONS.md, Working/Q/PREDICTIONS_COMBAT.md (its UNKNOWN rows), the armour report of 7951 and the loadout table. Rows: cannon shell, Vulcan round, barrage missile per round, Immobiliser (60.0 hit damage and the permanent stun on unarmoured vehicles), EMP burst (fixed stun, no damage), riot bolt (zero damage plus impulse), hacker, sonar. For each: BmAK value, the JC3 carrier member and its current value in the private tune, and the shots-to-kill against the 1,200 HP reference and the 36,000 HP build health gate. Operator facts: the EMP burst is a tap with a fixed stun and permanently disables unarmoured vehicles. Output: Working/Roadmap/weapon_damage_table.json. Done-check: all eight rows exist and every empty value is the string UNKNOWN with the missing source named. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The winch row T-WP6 is blocked only because nobody wrote the closest-system plan, and STAGES.md forbids answering that JC3 has none. Read Research/JC3Grab/TETHER.md, tmp/freebuff/reports/winch-and-tether.md, OPERATOR_PRIORITIES.md (lead: Rico grapple and tether) and the BmAK winch data in Research/BatmobileGrab/WEAPONS.md (two RSimpleRopeComponent, WinchOrigin socket, Play_BML_WinchFire and _Attatch). Compare two candidates: (a) a grapple fired from the car using the FIRE_GRAPPLE and dualtether_test_to_vehicle.gdc carriers, (b) an authored rope part with CVehicleCargoBay-style anchoring. For each, list members used, the gap to BmAK, and what an agent-piloted test would show. Pick one and justify it. Output: tmp/freebuff/reports/winch-build-plan.md plus a proposed replacement row for T-WP6 in Working/Roadmap/winch_row_proposal.jsonl. Done-check: the plan names the chosen candidate and lists at least four concrete steps with file names. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Fix the Immobiliser (EMP missile) target rules on paper before the build and the probes rely on them. Operator facts: it is the only pursuit weapon, it needs the tracker tag, and the EMP effect permanently disables unarmoured vehicles; tanks and drones are only stunned (operator lead, unverified). Read the report of 7997, Working/Translation/T_WP4D_TRACKER_EMP.md, GRAB_BACKLOG.md lines 169-170 and tmp/freebuff/reports/immobilizer-vs-emp-missile.md. Answer: what damage and impact sound the fired archetype carries (60.0 on the Immobiliser; the _ForCars archetype value is UNKNOWN until you read it), which target classes the BmAK code can address, and what the stun duration field is for non-vehicle targets. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/immobiliser-target-rules.md with a table class x outcome x source and a list of what only the in-game probe can answer. Done-check: every target class (car, tank, helicopter drone, soldier) has a cell, UNKNOWN allowed. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Find what could make a single SAM site change side. Known: the SAM hack leaves only the event 5D26E95A and no faction write (tmp/freebuff/reports/sam-hack-allegiance-state.md); no allegiance member in 295 wiring dumps; the base-liberation flip is the only known side change (report of 7961). Operator facts: a hacked SAM stops firing at the player and fires at enemy aircraft only; drones cannot be hacked, but can be Rebel Dropped as friendly. Search exported entity data in E:/Modding/JustCause3/_grab/entities and Research/JC3Grab/ENTITIES.md and VOCABULARY.md for: who listens to 5D26E95A, the faction member on SAM mounts, a friendly SAM variant, and any exe consumer found by 9050. Rank three composed routes: swap to a friendly turret entity, event injection through the native hook, visual only. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/sam-flip-routes.md with each route, its evidence, and the probe that would prove it. Done-check: three routes ranked with a first probe each. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

RC4 put the missile tunes on a CBulletWeaponBase component because B-05 cloned the APC bullet weapon for all four weapons (Builds/bm-RC4-weapons/receipt.json limit L-1, carrier_class_mismatch 2). Rebuild the two missile weapons (barrage and Immobiliser) on a carrier whose class is the missile weapon base. Find a shipped vehicle entity whose weapon component is that missile class (Research/JC3Grab/WEAPON_WIRING.md, the donor of w618_sportsmuscle_missile), clone it into a private entity, attach the w618 clone tunes from the 9101 slot map, and write the AutoAim cone using the unit verdict in tmp/freebuff/reports/autoaim-angle-unit.md. If no carrier exists, record the exact member gap and keep the bullet carrier with a flagged limit. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_missile_carrier.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-mcarrier, registered as a branch for the 9100 merge. Done-check: --check reports carrier_class_mismatch 0, or the gap card exists. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Independent read-back of the missile carrier rebuild. Run the --check mode of Tools/scripts/rc5_missile_carrier.py, then, without trusting it, re-read Builds/bm-RC5-mcarrier with Tools/scripts/jc3weapons.py --check --root on that tree. Confirm for both missile weapons: component class name, tune file name, w618 fire-block values unchanged versus the donor, guidance members (turning speed 300 with random 60, acceleration 30 to 65, random 2 to 5), AutoAim cone and MaxAimDistance 120 m, and that no object id dangles (compare with the dangling-reference method of the R wave report rc5-dangling-fire-refs.md). Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-missile-carrier.md with PASS or FAIL per item and the first failing byte offset or member. Done-check: the report has one line per item and the exit status of both check commands is quoted. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Add the tracker behaviours that the 9103 launcher and marker leave out. Operator facts: the signal weakens with distance, the tracked vehicle stays visible through walls when close, the tracker HUD persists into battle, and yellow versus grey marks the state. Follow tmp/freebuff/reports/tracker-signal-range-and-wall-visibility.md and tracker-lock-hud-plan.md: the distance string rule (metres versus kilometres, MCI_distance.TXT_distance), the marker swap by removal then creation, the through-wall flag on the point of interest, and the mm130_tracker style graph if the plan adopted it. Where the weakening has no JC3 member, build the closest compose (marker alpha or colour stepped by distance bands) and write the gap down. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_tracker_world.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-trackerworld, branch for the merge. Done-check: --check lists every band, the string rule, and the persisted-into-battle flag, with zero dangling references. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Verify the tracker build offline. Re-run --check of Tools/scripts/rc5_tracker_world.py, then compare its output with the plan in tmp/freebuff/reports/tracker-lock-hud-plan.md and the report of 7960 (tracker marker carrier). Test the distance-to-string rule by feeding 12 sample distances (0, 9, 10, 999, 1000, 1001, 5000, 20000 metres and four of your choice) through the function the script uses and tabulate the produced text. Check the marker types used are 19 (yellow) and 24 (grey) exactly as the plan states, and that the HUD movie symbol names exist in the extracted hud.gfx data used by 9160. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-tracker-world.md with PASS or FAIL per check and the table. Done-check: 12 conversions listed and each state change is traced to a code line. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

BmAK weapons have unlimited ammo; only cadence and WeaponCoolDown pace them. Apply that to the private weapon tunes: write unlimited_ammo, magazine_size and reload_time_scale in the four weapon tunes of the RC5 trees, and the cooldown values of tmp/freebuff/reports/ammo-types-and-reload-plan.md and weapon-slot-inputs-prep-list.md (EMP burst 2.0 s, hacker 1.0 s, the EMP missile and tracker values from the plan; cannon 2.0 s; Vulcan interval 0.138 s). ReloadSoundDuration 0.4 s is a sound length, not a magazine reload; do not use it as one. Every number without a source in those reports stays untouched and is listed as UNKNOWN. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_ammo.py (--write, --check) over copies in Builds/bm-RC5-ammo, branch for the merge. Done-check: --check prints each member, its old value, its new value and its source; no member is written without a source. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Offline read-back of the ammo and cooldown edits. Use Tools/scripts/jc3weapons.py --check --root Builds/bm-RC5-ammo and the --check of rc5_ammo.py, then diff each tune against its donor and list every changed member. Confirm that only the members the plan in tmp/freebuff/reports/ammo-types-and-reload-plan.md names have changed, that the fire-block values of w618 are intact, and that the Vulcan interval 0.1 to 0.138 change from the RC4 receipt (Builds/bm-RC4-weapons/receipt.json) is still present. Flag any member whose type is wrong for the value written (integer written as float and the reverse). Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-ammo-tunes.md with the diff table and PASS or FAIL per tune. Done-check: the table covers all four tunes plus the riot tune, and the number of changed members matches the number the build report claims. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

The EMP burst decoded in Working/Translation/T_WP5B_EMP_BURST.md has four power levels (disable 2, 4, 8, 12 s; charge 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5 s; range 75 m; impulse 15000; cooldown 2.0 s). Operator fact: in play the burst is a tap with a fixed stun, and the stun permanently disables unarmoured vehicles. So build the tap as the default and keep the four-level hold as the decoded data path, not as the player-facing rule; record this conflict in the report instead of picking silently. Wire the level into the HUD draw call DrawWeaponPowerLevel through the 9160 caller (reports/hud-radar-dash-plans-v2.md), and the level selection into the weapon tune of 9107 as the closest compose; name the gap if JC3 has no hold-time member. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_emp_levels.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-emplevels. Done-check: --check prints the four levels with their values and the tap default. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Verify the burst level build offline. Run the --check mode of Tools/scripts/rc5_emp_levels.py and compare every printed number with Working/Translation/T_WP5B_EMP_BURST.md (range 75 m, disable 2/4/8/12 s, charge 0/0.5/1/1.5 s, impulse 15000, cooldown 2.0 s). Confirm the tap default is flagged as the operator rule and the level table as decoded data. Check that the HUD call name matches the one listed in Research/JC3Grab/JC3_HUD_WEAPONS.md and that the movie clip it targets exists in the 9160 output. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-emp-levels.md: one row per number (expected, found, PASS or FAIL) and a final line stating whether a missing capability card is still open. Done-check: seven numeric rows and the HUD name check are present. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

No brief owns the cockpit gadget meshes. BmAK has Drone_Hacker.GadgetMesh, Batmobile_Sonar.GadgetMesh and Vehicle_Tracker.GadgetMesh, and the booster ring of 9106 is the fourth (rank 2). Read Working/Translation/T_ROWS.jsonl rows T-WP7, T-WP8, T-WP9 and T-WP11, the moving-parts method of 9172 (Working/Translation/T8_PARTS.md) and the grab in Research/BatmobileGrab/MESHES.json. For each mesh give size, socket and deploy trigger; build the three non-booster ones as movable parts bound to the gadget state, using the 9172 binding mechanism, with the nearest authored stand-in if the real mesh is missing (flag it as a stand-in, never as the BmAK mesh). Script Tools/scripts/rc5_gadget_meshes.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-gadgetmesh. Done-check: --check lists three parts with socket, trigger and asset path, zero dangling. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Check the gadget mesh build offline, including the booster ring built by 9106. Run --check of Tools/scripts/rc5_gadget_meshes.py. Then, using the silhouette and geometry scripts under Tools/scripts (silhouette_check.py, jc3geom.py), confirm that each part sits within the car bounds, that the booster ring is 18 nozzles on a ring of about 34 cm at z 2.989 m, and that no part collides with the cockpit volume. Confirm each deploy trigger refers to a state that exists in the entity (nitro for the booster; the gadget state names from the 9101 slot map for the rest). Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-gadget-meshes.md with a PASS or FAIL for geometry, binding and stand-in flag per part. Done-check: four parts are listed and each stand-in is explicitly labelled. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Build the missile-bay animation that 9110 only mentions. BmAK has six bay bones that rotate 14.99 degrees and translate 10.87 cm to open in 0.833 s and close again (Research/BatmobileGrab/ANIMATIONS.md, tmp/freebuff/reports/missile-pod-salvo-plan.md and weapon-bay-animation-plan.md). Use the moving-part method of 9172 to bind the six bays to the barrage fire event: open on lock start, hold during the salvo, close after the last round. The barrage fires itself at lock (operator fact), so the open trigger is the lock, not a button. If JC3 offers no open-on-lock trigger, build the closest compose and write the gap. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_missile_bays.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-bays. Done-check: --check prints six bays with axis, angle, translation, duration and the trigger source. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Read back the missile bay build. Run --check of Tools/scripts/rc5_missile_bays.py and compare to Research/BatmobileGrab/ANIMATIONS.md: six bays, 14.99 degrees, 10.87 cm, 0.833 s, matching the key counts (26 keys on close). Confirm every bay bone name exists in the car skeleton data used by 9172 and that the animation file lengths equal the duration times the frame rate. Check that the bays do not sit on the same socket as MissileL and MissileR in a way that would block the projectile spawn (use Research/BatmobileGrab/SOCKETS_JC3.md positions). Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-missile-bays.md, PASS or FAIL per check, with the measured numbers. Done-check: all six bays have a line and the socket clearance result is stated. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Wire the 60 mm cannon reload circle. Operator fact: the cannon is on RT and shows a circle that fills while it reloads. Inputs: the report of 7959 (reload time source, circle art, fill direction, anchor), tmp/freebuff/reports/cannon-60mm-reload-circle-plan.md, and the HUD API in Research/JC3Grab/JC3_HUD_WEAPONS.md (InitVehicleWeapons weapon_cooldown 0..1 and UC_SetCannonCoolDown). In the 9160 HUD tree, connect the cannon weapon cooldown to the cannon circle clip, fill 0 to 1 over the cannon cadence, and keep the Vulcan clip separate. BmAK has no magazine, so the circle shows cadence only. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_hud_cannon.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-hudcannon, branch for the merge. Done-check: --check lists the clip name, anchor, duration and the member that drives it. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Wire the Vulcan crosshair bloom. Operator facts: the Vulcan is on RB, the crosshair spreads while firing, turns red at the top, and nothing ever locks it out. Use Research/BatmobileGrab/VULCAN_BLOOM.json (curve and red threshold), tmp/freebuff/reports/vulcan-spinup-and-heat-plan.md and the HUD call UC_SetMachineGunAccuracyFrame from Research/JC3Grab/JC3_HUD_WEAPONS.md. In the 9160 HUD tree, drive the accuracy frame from fire time with the measured curve and shrink it on release; if the frame scale is UNKNOWN, build the table for a normalised 0..1 input and mark the scale as the open item. Add an assertion that fire never stops at red. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_hud_bloom.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-hudbloom. Done-check: --check prints the sample table, the red frame, and the no-lockout assertion. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Verify both weapon HUD wires offline. Run --check of Tools/scripts/rc5_hud_cannon.py and rc5_hud_bloom.py. For the cannon: fill direction, anchor and duration against the report of 7959. For the Vulcan: re-evaluate the bloom table at 0, 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 s and compare against Research/BatmobileGrab/VULCAN_BLOOM.json within the stated tolerance. Confirm that both clip names exist in the extracted hud.gfx used by 9160, that no clip is driven by two writers, and that the two tunes do not call the same HUD function on one slot. Output tmp/freebuff/reports/verify-weapon-hud-wires.md with PASS or FAIL per item and the five bloom values. Done-check: the report lists clip names and quotes both check commands' exit status. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Ship the muzzle flash, recoil and impact payloads for the cannon and both missile weapons through the proven effect writer (Tools/scripts/effc_writer.py, 95 of 95 byte-identical in effc-format-writable.md). Use tmp/freebuff/reports/cannon-recoil-and-muzzle-plan.md, the ledger rows T-FX10 to T-FX16 in Working/Translation/T_ROWS.jsonl, and the socket positions CannonMuzzle, MissileL and MissileR in Research/BatmobileGrab/SOCKETS_JC3.md. Write private effect copies and the recoil kick values the plan names, patching each member at its decoded offset in carry mode; list each member that has no counterpart as an open gap. Do not touch the trail and launch flash that 9102 already ships. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_fx_cannon.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-fxcannon. Done-check: --check lists each effect file, each patched member and a byte-identical carry for the rest. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Vulcan payloads that no shipped brief covers: barrel spin-up, ejected casings, and the tracer (ledger rows T-FX10 to T-FX16, RC4 receipt flag tracer_unchanged). Read tmp/freebuff/reports/vulcan-spinup-and-heat-plan.md, tracer-width-and-ribbon-units.md and the barrel-spin part row T-12 in T_ROWS.jsonl. Operator fact: the Vulcan has no heat lockout, so there is no overheat effect; only the red crosshair, which the HUD brief owns. Build private effect copies with Tools/scripts/effc_writer.py, and bind the barrel spin to the fire state through the 9172 moving-part mechanism if the plan allows. Script Tools/scripts/rc5_fx_vulcan.py (--write, --check), tree Builds/bm-RC5-fxvulcan. Done-check: --check lists spin-up time, casing effect, tracer width and length with sources, and shows no overheat asset. Shared rules: E:/Modding/JustCause3/JC3-Batmobile/tmp/freebuff/INSTRUCTIONS.md.

Verify both effect payload builds. Run Tools/scripts/effc_writer.py check on every .effc under Builds/bm-RC5-fxcannon and Builds/bm-RC5-fxvulcan, and the --check of rc5_fx_cannon.py and rc5_fx_vulcan.py.
